prompt:
Stylised low-poly isometric fantasy game art, light-neutral.
Flat faceted shapes built from a few large flat planes with crisp hard edges, like cut paper or a clean vector illustration.
NO LIGHTING AT ALL: every material is one single flat base colour on all its facets, with no lit side, no shadow side, no highlights, no gradients and no glow; facets are shown only by a very thin, slightly darker seam where two planes meet. No outlines, no texture, no noise.
A small harmonious palette of soft, muted warm pastels (sand, terracotta, dusty rose, sage green, teal, cream, brass). No writing anywhere.
The first image is a layout sketch: a dark door arch on a magenta background. Paint finished, richly detailed game art over it:
the front door of the building is exactly where the dark arch is, at the middle of the bottom edge,
the same size as the arch. Paint the whole building around that door, filling the frame from side to side and top to bottom, with its natural outline.
with a few short steps or a threshold leading down from the door to the bottom edge. Nothing else stands in front of the door.
The other images show the approved art style and, where it is the same place, how it looked before: keep its character.
Biome: Frostpeak; its light and mood.
Subject: The Sunken Drafts, the whole building seen from outside, classic 2:1 isometric view, looking down at about 30 degrees from one corner, standing upright. a cavernous mine entrance carved into the sheer mountain bedrock: rough-hewn stone arches reinforced with heavy cedar timbers, iron rail tracks leading into the deep whistling subterranean darkness, and flickering oil lanterns.
Background: one flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) filling everything behind the building, with no ground, scenery, gradient, glow or shadow on it. No magenta anywhere in the building. Lanterns and windows have no glow or halo spilling onto the background.
Avoid: photorealistic, painterly, watercolour, brush strokes, anime cel shading, outlines, thick black outlines, shading, cast shadow, drop shadow, highlights, gradients, glow, texture, noise, pure black, pure white, harsh contrast, neon, lens flare, blur, top-down view, text, letters, words, labels with writing, watermark, signature, frame, border, vignette, background scenery, cast shadow on the background.
